cards.verse_text: The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.
cards.snippet: The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.

cards.card_text: He asks if Paul can persuade him to become a Christian that fast He says he gave up on the prophets long ago He tells the guards to take Paul away right now
cards.verse_text: Then Agrippa said to Paul, “Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”
cards.snippet: …“Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”

cards.card_text: But if a believer suffers as a Christian, Peter says not to be ___, and to glorify God for bearing that name.
cards.verse_text: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
cards.snippet: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
